characters.name: Faderen
characters.description: A middle-aged man from an impoverished family, appearing tall and somewhat gaunt. He wears a patched-up shirt with a noticeably new sleeve. With a determined yet somewhat embarrassed expression, he tries to manifest an air of wealth. He holds one arm behind his back while using the new sleeve to dust furniture, showcasing a mix of hopefulness and desperation in his demeanor.

characters.name: Konen
characters.description: The wife of the impoverished family, middle-aged and petite with a practical build. She wears a simple outfit highlighting a new shoe, which she uses to kick furniture around while making comments on the disorder. Her expression is a blend of forced pride and unease, trying to maintain appearances for their guest.

characters.name: Datteren
characters.description: A young woman from the poor household, appearing delicate and modestly attractive. She dons a new bonnet that she proudly shows off by peeking from doorways and nodding her head. Her demeanor is somewhat playful and coy as she avoids fully entering the room, suggesting a mix of shyness and coquettishness.

characters.name: Jenten
characters.description: A beautiful and kind-hearted young girl, the daughter of a poor hunter. She has a fair complexion, slender build, and long, dark hair. Wearing simple yet clean attire, her face often shows determination mixed with vulnerability. She appears both physically and emotionally resolute as she leaves her rural home to seek work, her expressions reflecting hope and slight uncertainty for the future.

characters.name: Dronningen
characters.description: A regal and elegant woman, slightly older, with a commanding yet gentle presence. She wears finely embroidered royal garments, her demeanor both gracious and authoritative. Her expressions often convey a blend of curiosity and stern judgment, valuing craftsmanship and handwork highly.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: A handsome young man of noble bearing, with a strong, attractive build. He is seen at the wedding banquet, adorned in royal garb suited for such an occasion. His demeanor is mostly cheerful and intrigued, though slightly perturbed when introduced to the bride’s unusual 'aunts.' His expressions range from admiration for his bride to mild concern at her familial connections.

characters.name: Mostrene
characters.description: Three elderly women, each with an exaggerated physical trait. One has an absurdly long nose, the other a broad back, and the third is characterized by large, red, watery eyes. Their appearances are grotesque and unsettling, contrasting sharply with the beauty of the present wedding guests. Their demeanor is humble, each explaining their disfigurement with a tone of resignation earned through lifelong toil in spinning, weaving, and sewing.
